description: A Fastify plugin for capturing HTTP requests and responses for shadow testing, including request/response logging, request ID assignment, and request/response buffering.

methods.name: captureRequest
methods.description: Saves request data, manages request buffer, and writes to log file if buffer exceeds size.

methods.name: captureReply
methods.description: Saves reply data, manages response buffer, and writes to log file if buffer exceeds size.

methods.name: omit
methods.description: Returns a subset of an object or array with specified properties or items removed.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Returns a subset of an object or array with only specified properties or items included.
